```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(NanoQuRe)
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools) # Required to render lists of interactive HTML widgets

samples_split <- split(params$data, params$data$sample_id)

# one line of values per sample under each section description
caption_by_sample <- function(section) {
  values <- vapply(samples_split, function(s)
    NanoQuRe:::caption_numbers(section, s, params$platform), character(1))
  cat(paste0("- **", names(samples_split), "**: ", values, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
}
```

## Sequencing Statistics Table
```{r, echo=FALSE}
lapply(samples_split, sequencing_stats) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  DT::datatable(caption = 'Table 1: Sequencing Summary Statistics')
```


## Quality Statistics Table
```{r, echo=FALSE}
lapply(samples_split, quality_stats) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  DT::datatable(caption = 'Table 2: Sequencing Summary Quality Statistics')
```

## Read Lengths
`r NanoQuRe:::caption_description("read_lengths")`

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
caption_by_sample("read_lengths")
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
htmltools::tagList(lapply(samples_split, plot_read_lengths))
```

## Length and Qscore
`r NanoQuRe:::caption_description("length_qscore")`

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}

```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
htmltools::tagList(lapply(samples_split, function(s) {
  double_results <- plot_double(s)
  htmltools::tagList(double_results$length_plot, double_results$qscore_plot)
}))
```



## Pore activity heatmap
`r NanoQuRe:::caption_description("heatmap")`

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
caption_by_sample("heatmap")
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
htmltools::tagList(lapply(samples_split, function(s) {
  tryCatch(
    pore_activity_heatmap(s, platform = params$platform),
    error = function(e) {
      htmltools::tags$div(
        style = paste(
          "color:#9e2a2b; background:#fff3cd; border:1px solid #e69f00;",
          "padding:10px; border-radius:4px; margin-bottom:10px;"
        ),
        sprintf(
          "Pore activity heatmap could not be generated for sample '%s': %s",
          dplyr::first(s$sample_id), conditionMessage(e)
        )
      )
    }
  )
}))
```
